# Processes

## Service Topology

Git is a single-binary CLI tool — there is no long-running service or microservice mesh.
However several sub-processes and optional daemons exist:

| Process | Role |
|---------|------|
| `git` (main binary) | Dispatcher — resolves subcommand, forks appropriate handler |
| `git-daemon` | Unauthenticated read-only server over the Git protocol (port 9418) |
| `git-http-backend` | CGI handler for smart HTTP transport |
| `ssh` (external) | Transport for `git@host:repo` URLs |
| `credential-cache--daemon` | Background daemon caching credentials in a Unix socket |
| `upload-pack` / `receive-pack` | Server-side pack negotiation (spawned per connection) |

## Build Commands

| Action | Command |
|--------|---------|
| Full build | `make` / `make all` |
| Configure (optional) | `make configure && ./configure` |
| Install | `make install` |
| Clean | `make clean` |
| Compile commands (IDE) | `make compile_commands.json` |

## Test Commands

| Action | Command |
|--------|---------|
| Full test suite | `make test` |
| Single script | `sh t/tNNNN-description.sh` |
| Unit tests | built as part of `make test` |
| Performance tests | `make -C t/perf` |

## CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions)

Workflows in `.github/workflows/`:

| Workflow | Trigger | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `main.yml` | push / pull_request | Full multi-platform build & test matrix |
| `check-style.yml` | push / pull_request | clang-format style check |
| `check-whitespace.yml` | push / pull_request | Trailing whitespace / line-ending check |
| `coverity.yml` | scheduled [?] | Static analysis via Coverity Scan |
| `l10n.yml` | push / pull_request | Localisation file validation |

The `main.yml` workflow uses a `ci-config` branch mechanism to allow per-repo
CI enablement and skip-if-redundant optimisation (deduplicates runs for identical
commit trees).

## Environment Variables

Key variables referenced in build/test:

| Variable | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `DEVELOPER` | Enables extra compiler warnings (set to `1` in CI) |
| `NO_CURL` | Disables HTTP transport |
| `NO_OPENSSL` | Disables OpenSSL |
| `NO_PERL` | Disables Perl scripted commands |
| `NO_PYTHON` | Disables Python scripted commands |
| `GIT_TEST_*` | Numerous test-mode flags (see `t/README`) |

## Deployment

Distributed as source. Packaged by OS vendors (apt, brew, etc.) or built from source.
No container image or cloud deployment artefact is produced by this repository.
